title: gossypium arboreum var. perrieri
intro: Gossypium arboreum var. perrieri, commonly known as the Madagascar cotton tree, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gossypium arboreum var. perrieri include wound healing, reduction of inflammation, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
